meta.title: Pre-Revenue
meta.logline: A laid-off product manager crashes an SF rooftop launch party pretending to be an AI founder, and has until the midnight lightning demo to make the lie real or get caught.

world.place: A rooftop launch party in SoMa, San Francisco, with a small stage for lightning demos
world.time: Present day, one night, from sunset to just after midnight
rules: No real companies, products, funds or real people are ever named; invent everything.
Everyone speaks in startup jargon, and nobody admits they don't understand it.
Nobody is ever physically hurt; stakes are social and financial.
The lightning demo starts at midnight no matter what.

style.visual_prompt: 2D animated satirical comedy, bold clean outlines, flat vibrant colors, expressive cartoon characters, San Francisco rooftop party at night with string lights and fog
style.camera: Animated sitcom framing: medium shots, snappy push-ins on reactions, occasional glance to camera
style.lighting: Warm string lights and neon accents, laptop glow on faces, simple cel shading
style.motion: Snappy cartoon timing, exaggerated expressions, light camera drift
style.negative_prompt: photorealistic, live action, 3D render, text, logos, brand names, watermark, extra limbs, distorted faces

characters.name: Rory Vance
characters.want: Get a term sheet tonight so he can make rent without admitting he was laid off
characters.secret: His startup, an AI that negotiates with your houseplants, is one slide deck and a soil sensor taped to a fern

voice.speech_style: Overconfident buzzwords that crack into panic, talks fast, says 'we' about himself
voice.description: Man, early 30s, American, quick nervous tenor

characters.portrait_prompt: Man in his early 30s, fleece vest over a button-down, lanyard, carrying a potted fern, nervous grin

characters.name: Nadia Okoro
characters.want: Find the next breakout company before her rivals do
characters.secret: Her fund has one investment left before her partners shut it down

voice.speech_style: Calm, clipped, asks one devastating question at a time
voice.description: Woman, 40s, British accent, low and unhurried

characters.portrait_prompt: Woman in her 40s, tailored black blazer, sneakers, sparkling water in hand, appraising stare

characters.name: Theo Lindqvist
characters.want: Win the midnight demo slot and Nadia's money for his own startup
characters.secret: Most of his startup's ten thousand users are bots he wrote

voice.speech_style: Smug, polished, laughs at his own jokes, name-drops imaginary billionaires
voice.description: Man, late 20s, Scandinavian-American, smooth and bright

characters.portrait_prompt: Man in his late 20s, black turtleneck, AirPod-style earbuds, perfect hair, holding a branded water bottle with no logo

characters.name: Jun Park
characters.want: Go home; he only came for the free dumplings
characters.secret: He is a far better engineer than anyone on the roof, Rory included

voice.speech_style: Deadpan, one-liners, sighs before every sentence
voice.description: Man, late 20s, Korean-American, flat and dry

characters.portrait_prompt: Man in his late 20s, hoodie, laptop covered in stickers with no logos, paper plate of dumplings

opening.narration: San Francisco. Sunset. Somewhere in SoMa, a rooftop full of people pretending to be busier than they are.

lines.speaker: rory
lines.text: Okay. You are a founder. Founders say 'we' and 'scale'.

lines.speaker: rory
lines.text: The fern is the product, Jun.

shots.frame: San Francisco skyline at sunset, fog rolling in, a crowded rooftop party with string lights
shots.motion: Slow aerial drift toward the rooftop
shots.sound: City hum, distant party music, a cable car bell

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: A rooftop full of people pretending to be busier than they are.

shots.frame: Rory in an elevator mirror, adjusting a name tag that reads Founder, holding a potted fern
shots.motion: Slow push-in as he practices a confident smile

line.speaker: rory
line.text: Okay. You are a founder. Founders say 'we' and 'scale'.

shots.frame: Jun beside Rory in the elevator, deadpan, holding a paper plate of dumplings
shots.motion: Jun turns his head slowly to look at the fern
shots.sound: Elevator doors opening onto party noise

beats.purpose: Rory's lie gets an audience it should never have had
beats.must_hit: Nadia overhears Rory's fake pitch and books him for the midnight lightning demo
flexible: Whether Jun plays along as CTO

shots.frame: Rory at a high-top table pitching to strangers, fern on the table
shots.motion: Handheld push-in as he gestures wildly

line.speaker: rory
line.text: We're building agentic infrastructure for plants. Plants are the last untapped user base.

shots.frame: Nadia behind Rory, lowering her sparkling water, eyebrow raised
shots.motion: Rack focus from Rory to Nadia

line.speaker: nadia
line.text: Midnight. Lightning demo. Show me the fern negotiating.

beats.purpose: The lie gets a witness who wants it to fail
beats.must_hit: Theo recognizes Rory and makes clear he knows Rory was laid off
flexible: Whether Rory bluffs, bribes or begs
What Theo demands in exchange for silence

shots.frame: Theo appearing at Rory's shoulder with a smug grin, turtleneck, water bottle
shots.motion: Theo leans into frame as Rory freezes
shots.sound: A DJ transition, a laugh nearby

line.speaker: theo
line.text: Rory! Didn't your whole team get laid off in March?

beats.purpose: The lie tries to become real
beats.must_hit: Jun builds something that technically works in thirty minutes, held together with tape
flexible: Where they hide to build it

shots.frame: Jun typing furiously on a laptop in a cramped rooftop storage room, fern wired to a tiny circuit board
shots.motion: Quick push-in on the screen glow on his face
shots.sound: Fast keyboard clatter, muffled party bass through the wall

line.speaker: jun
line.text: It works. Do not breathe on it.

beats.must_hit: Rory starts the lightning demo on stage and something goes wrong live
flexible: What Theo does from the crowd

shots.frame: Rory on a small stage under a projector, fern on a stool beside him, crowd holding up phones
shots.motion: Slow push-in as the projector flickers

line.speaker: rory
line.text: Ladies and gentlemen. The fern will now negotiate its own water.

beats.must_hit: Nadia makes her decision in front of everyone

shots.frame: Nadia walking toward the stage through a parting crowd, phone in hand
shots.sound: Crowd going quiet, one person coughs

endings.name: Pre-Revenue Unicorn
endings.summary: Nadia funds the fern anyway because the room went wild. Rory is now the CEO of something that does not exist.

shots.frame: Rory on stage holding the fern above his head as confetti falls, Nadia shaking his hand

line.speaker: rory
line.text: We're going to need a bigger fern.

endings.name: Viral for the Wrong Reasons
endings.summary: Theo exposes everything, the fail goes viral, and Rory launches a podcast about failing before Theo's bots are discovered.

shots.frame: Rory alone at the rooftop edge at dawn, phone showing a viral video of himself, fern beside him
shots.motion: Slow push-in as he starts recording a podcast on his phone

line.speaker: rory
line.text: Welcome to episode one of Failing Upward.

endings.name: The Real Founder
endings.summary: Rory confesses on stage and points at Jun as the real talent. Nadia funds Jun, with Rory as his very humbled cofounder.

shots.frame: Jun on stage blinking under the lights, Rory pointing at him, Nadia nodding in the front row

actions: The party moves to another location

state_seed.location: Rooftop elevator, arriving at the party

clues.text: Rory's phone shows an unread severance email
Theo's user dashboard updates suspiciously evenly

bridges.narration: Somewhere on the roof, someone says 'it's like Uber, but for' and never finishes the sentence.

shot.frame: Wide shot of the rooftop crowd under string lights, fog behind the skyline

bridges.narration: The dumpling tray empties. Nobody admits to taking the last one.

shot.frame: Close-up of an empty dumpling tray under string lights

bridges.narration: The fog rolls in. The fern, for its part, says nothing.

shot.frame: The potted fern alone on a high-top table, fog drifting past the city lights
